subject: Dredge occupancy component with fixed detection component in occu()

messages.author: b73e473ed8cb5a54
messages.subject: Dredge occupancy component with fixed detection component in occu()
parts:
Hi all, 


I am dredging an unmarked occupancy model and have run into a obstacle. (I realize dredge {MuMIn} is not part of unmarked, but given that I am following up on a previous unmarked thread, I figured it was appropriate to ask here as well.)


After first dredging the detection component of the model, I am trying to dredge the occupancy component of the model with the fixed subset of predictors previously selected for the detection component:

global_occ <-occu( ~ Freq + I(Freq^2) + n  +mean_tree_d9 + mean_tree_kurt  ~ C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + S1 + S2 + S3 + S4 + Hour + I(Hour^2) + Deg_class + Freq_fire + age + Freq + mean_tree_d9 + mean_tree_d4 + mean_tree_d2 + mean_shrub_stdev + mean_tree_kurt + mean_tree_mad, umf_all)

system.time(dredge_occ<-pdredge(global_occ, rank=AIC, m.max=5, cluster=clust, fixed=`p(Freq)`&`p(I(Freq^2))`&`p(n)`&`p(mean_tree_d9)`&`p(mean_tree_kurt)`))


> dredge_occ

Global model call: occu(formula = ~Freq + I(Freq^2) + n + mean_tree_d9 + mean_tree_kurt ~ 
    C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + S1 + S2 + S3 + S4 + Hour + I(Hour^2) + 
        Deg_class + Freq_fire + age + Freq + mean_tree_d9 + mean_tree_d4 + 
        mean_tree_d2 + mean_shrub_stdev + mean_tree_kurt + mean_tree_mad, data = umf_all)
---
Model selection table 
   p(Int) psi(Int) p(Frq) p(I(Frq^2)) p(men_tre_d9) p(men_tre_krt)    p(n) df    logLik     AIC delta weight
31  -8.68    -1.93 -8.518      -2.439       -0.2369        -0.2295 0.07039  7 -9664.791 19343.6     0      1
Models ranked by AIC(x)


However, the model list is blank, and only seems to evaluate the fixed detection component with a NULL occupancy component. Am I using the fixed parameter incorrectly?


Thanks, 

Danielle

messages.author: b73e473ed8cb5a54
messages.subject: Re: Dredge occupancy component with fixed detection component in occu()
parts:
Here's the answer, thanks to Kamil Barton, for anyone else who may be in a similar bind in the future:

The unmarked thread I had previously linked to wasn't entirely correct. The formula syntax isn't appropriate for my needs, as it keeps one component of the occupancy model fixed (in this case, the detection component) and does not dredge the other component. To keep the detection component fixed and dredge the occupancy component, the subset expression should instead be a character vector: 
pdredge(global_occ, rank=AIC, m.max=5, cluster=clust, fixed=c("p(Freq)", "p(I(Freq^2))", "p(n)", "p(mean_tree_d9)", "p(mean_tree_kurt)"))
